risk_note: RV2 (apps/api/src/modules/payout/**, app.module.ts). Production wiring gaps 7 and 8 (orchestrator 11-02 03:49, moved from withdraw to pay). GET /v1/wallet/summary: withdrawn_fen now sums amount_fen of the user's PAID_API / PAID_MANUAL withdrawals through a new payout read port on the summary's read transaction (BR-FUND-18; not net_fen); risk_paused_reason also answers account_frozen for an effective withdraw_holds row, judged row by row on the injected Clock, any reason, source not disclosed (BR-FUND-18, BR-WDR-05). No new public text: account_frozen is already in the dictionary. No schema, contract or ledger change. appealing stays as it was: BR-FUND-18 names only frozen, noted, not ruled on.

reviews.note: round 1 (couli-runs/B2-05p/review-codex.json), no findings. Static review, no tests run.

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude each round. r1 fail: 2 S1 (frozen without a hold not pinned; several holds passable by a first-row read) and 1 S2 (banned not pinned). r2 fail: 1 S1 (passable by a last-row read). Each fixed by a new independent Claude; r3 pass with no findings.

longrun.note: no change under test/properties, packages/money, packages/domain or packages/testing; the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head
